vectors.name: synthesized_defaults_v0
vectors.why: Every field this version declares, at its protocol default. Synthesized so the message is held to Apache Kafka's bytes at all; hand-written cases carry the interesting shapes.

vectors.name: a_voter_with_endpoints_and_a_feature_range
vectors.why: The deepest nesting in the data set: an array of structs, each holding another array of structs and an inline struct. It also carries a uint16 port, which is the only unsigned width most schemas never exercise.
